_what: Harness defects, by the run or review that surfaced them. RECORD ONLY -- nothing reads this to make a decision.
_why: Founder ruling 2026-08-23. Fable's Q3 dissent: the phrase 'demonstrably closer to iron-clad' needs a convergence curve -- defects found per run over time -- and nothing tracked it. The founder's extension: the same series could later feed the capability mechanics, since a falling harness-defect rate is evidence the instrument is stable enough for its competence measurements to be trusted. Speculative how; costless to record now.
_the_measure: This is gamma applied one level up. gamma measures findings-per-round WITHIN a run and rises as discovery saturates. This ledger measures harness-defects-per-run ACROSS runs. Same Duane NHPP shape, same interpretation: the CUMULATIVE curve flattening and the RATE curve decaying are one event, not two.
_honesty: Seeded from the record, not from measurement in flight. Entries before 2026-08-23 are RECONSTRUCTED from commits and notes and are marked so. A reconstructed count is a lower bound: defects nobody found are not in it, and that is the limitation this series can never escape.
_attribution: author = who wrote the defect. finder = who found it. Both matter: a project whose defects are all its own assistant's has a different problem from one whose defects are all in vendor code.
